text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Mile Championship on the horizon, Taiki Shuttle seeks to make a bigger name for herself in order to become Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the midst of this, she is met with a challenge from Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Taiki can steal the hearts of the fans by beating the unstoppable force that is Silence Suzuka, she just might be able to clinch the title.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle's chances of becoming Umamusume of the Year hinge on winning the Mile Championship!
